name.value: the bear, the fish, the root & the berry

description.value: Situated at Spirit Ridge Resort on the shores of Osoyoos Lake, this Indigenous-inspired restaurant takes its name and culinary philosophy from the Syilx People's Four Food Chiefs creation story. The kitchen celebrates South Okanagan terroir through dishes built around bison, wild salmon, bannock, bitterroot, and an extensive list of local estate wines. It is a full-service destination restaurant offering breakfast, lunch, weekend brunch, and dinner in one of BC's premier wine-country cycling corridors.
